description: Change the scene's 3D map (the set the scene is built in) and/or move it. 'no' comes from studio_search_catalog with catalog='map'; -1 removes the map entirely. Loading a map is a full Unity scene load, so this call takes a moment and clears Studio's undo stack. Every field is optional and absolute; 'pos'/'rot' are applied after the new map has settled, because Studio resets the map transform whenever a map is set — including when it is the map already loaded. 'option' and 'light' toggle the map's own optional objects and lights and are refused on a map that has none. Returns the resulting map state.

no.description: map id from studio_search_catalog (catalog='map'), or -1 to remove the map

option.description: show the map's optional objects; only if map.option_available

light.description: show the map's own lights; only if map.light_available

loaded.description: whether the map's objects are actually in the scene

option_available.description: false when this map has no optional objects — 'option' is refused then

light_available.description: false when this map has no lights of its own — 'light' is refused then
